verdict: Meta leads surging efficiently; overdue build-out milestones need to catch up.
narrative: This period, your Meta campaigns delivered a real efficiency breakthrough — leads jumped 228% week-over-week while cost per lead dropped to $6.15, on nearly the same spend. That said, the full program is not yet running at the scale it was designed for: nine planned milestones — including search campaigns, automated nurture sequences, and local search verification — are overdue, which is limiting how far the paid momentum can go. We are actively working to close those gaps before the Phase 1 deadline at the end of September. Once those pieces are live, you should see broader lead volume and a measurable pipeline signal to track leads from first contact through to booked appointments.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days through Meta, at $6.15 cost per lead
increase in leads this past week versus the week before, on flat spend
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and site visits

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking shows zero downstream bookings across 3,370 site sessions this period, meaning we cannot yet confirm how many leads are turning into appointments.
watch_item.fix: Intake funnel tracking is being connected so that next period's report can show the full picture from ad click to booked visit.
